mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC is in a persistent four-week downtrend (3.7 to 0.6 to -4.4 to -13.3), and week-over-week decay is accelerating rather than flattening, so the negative momentum carries into the next 28 days and the forward mean stays below the trailing mean of -3.35.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell in each of the last three weekly means, ending at -13.3
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to the trailing 28-day mean of -3.35, i.e. the downtrend flattens or reverses within four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing below -5 percent change from baseline (it reached -8.7 at t-0w) marks a collapse in discretionary trip-making, and because retail-and-recreation trips are the most transit-dependent discretionary category, RETAIL_REC continues to fall over the following fortnight.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -5.0 percent change from baseline (observed -8.7 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT dropped from 3.3 at t-3w to -8.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT is below -5.0, RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is equal to or above its trailing-28-day mean, i.e. transit collapse fails to drag retail lower.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling to -16.7 while RESIDENTIAL rises to 9.3 shows activity being re-absorbed into the home rather than into commercial venues, so out-of-home leisure and shopping trips keep shrinking and RETAIL_REC is lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 12.3 points across four weekly means while RESIDENTIAL rose 4.4 points
failure_condition: When PARKS is below -10 and RESIDENTIAL is above +8 in the same week, the forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC still exceeds the trailing mean, rejecting the home-substitution channel.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding near 49 percent above baseline for four consecutive weeks indicates precautionary household provisioning and reduced trip-chaining, which suppresses discretionary retail visits within one week even as total mobility stabilises.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean stays above 45 percent change from baseline for at least two consecutive weeks (observed 48.6 and 48.9 at t-1w and t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM has stayed between 48.6 and 53.7 across all four weekly means
failure_condition: The week-over-week change in RETAIL_REC turns positive in the immediate next week while GROCERY_PHARM remains above 45, rejecting the trip-substitution mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: The forward 28-day window contains the pre-Chinese New Year shopping ramp ahead of 1 February 2022, and elevated GROCERY_PHARM already at 48.9 shows households are in festive provisioning mode, so the seasonal spending impulse lifts RETAIL_REC above the depressed trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: calendar enters the 14-day pre-Chinese New Year window starting 2022-01-18 while GROCERY_PHARM is above 45
evidence_refs: fact:decision point 2022-01-15 sits 17 days before Chinese New Year 2022-02-01
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise above its trailing 28-day mean of -3.35 during the last two weeks of January 2022 despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above 45, rejecting the festive-ramp hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL climbing to 9.3 combined with WORKPLACES oscillating around zero indicates a work-from-home directive that removes commuting-linked retail footfall; as long as that combination persists, RETAIL_REC trends lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean rises above +8.0 while WORKPLACES weekly mean stays below 0.0 in the same week (observed at t-0w: 9.3 and -0.6)
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 4.9 at t-3w to 9.3 at t-0w while WORKPLACES ended at -0.6
failure_condition: Under the RESIDENTIAL>8 and WORKPLACES<0 regime, the forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or above the trailing mean, showing the WFH channel does not suppress retail.

mechanism_narrative: The single-week drop in RETAIL_REC of 8.9 points (from -4.4 to -13.3) overshoots the simultaneous change in PARKS and TRANSIT, so the level is stretched below its own four-week path and mechanical mean reversion pushes RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly mean drops more than 8 points week-on-week (observed -13.3 at t-0w versus -4.4 at t-1w)
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly change at t-0w was -8.9 points versus a PARKS weekly change of -7.6
failure_condition: After a week-on-week RETAIL_REC drop exceeding 8 points, the next 28-day mean remains below the trailing 28-day mean, rejecting the overshoot-reversion mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT falling to -8.7 while WORKPLACES is flat at -0.6 and RESIDENTIAL is at 9.3 means the residual out-of-home movement is being routed to essential errands rather than discretionary venues, so RETAIL_REC weakens further over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean is at least 5 points below the WORKPLACES weekly mean while RESIDENTIAL is above +8 (observed -8.7, -0.6, 9.3 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:at t-0w TRANSIT -8.7 is 8.1 points below WORKPLACES -0.6 with RESIDENTIAL at 9.3
failure_condition: When TRANSIT underperforms WORKPLACES by 5 or more points with RESIDENTIAL above +8, the following week's RETAIL_REC mean is higher than the week before, rejecting the essential-trip-routing mechanism.
